userConstraint: Mostly free or low cost. No numeric monthly budget or approval to change billing limits supplied.

pti.deployment: Docker built in GitHub Actions, pushed to existing Artifact Registry, deployed directly to Cloud Run in asia-south1
pti.billing: Deployment requires existing active billing. Actual invoice not inspected.

gtop.repoMcp: tools/gtop-mcp/src/index.ts uses StdioServerTransport, not a hosted HTTP deployment.
gtop.otherBackend: gtop-app/functions/index.mjs uses Firebase second-generation HTTP/Firestore-triggered Functions for paper services.
gtop.installedPlugin: GTOP Firestore plugin app-backed manifest references an App ID only. It contains no server URL, deployment configuration or billing data; exact connected connector hosting not established.

noveliaa.deployment: Firebase CLI second-generation HTTP Function, under existing Firebase Hosting and GitHub Actions.
noveliaa.whyAdditionalApis: Installed Firebase CLI prepare.js requires Cloud Run, Eventarc, Pub/Sub and Storage APIs for every gcfv2 backend. No Eventarc trigger or Pub/Sub topic is defined for this HTTP plugin.
noveliaa.whyServer: Remote MCP/OAuth requires a reachable authorization and scoped data-access service. Skills alone do not require this server.
noveliaa.aiInference: No OpenAI/Gemini model API calls, GPU or inference worker in the plugin server.

cloudRun.freeAllowance: Aggregated by billing account across projects

artifactRegistry.warning: Retained deployment images can accumulate while runtime compute remains within free tier.

cloudBuild.eligibleMachine: e2-standard-2 default pool only; eligibility and quota must not be assumed for all Functions builds
cloudBuild.builds: Deployment-time work, not author typing or MCP inference.

firestore.note: MCP calls can read multiple documents/chunks and auth metadata. One tool call is not one Firestore read; one new proposal is one collaboration document write plus any separate OAuth lifecycle operations.

eventarc.noveliaaEvents: No runtime event pipeline configured by this plugin.

cloudStorage.note: Deployment source archives/operations can cost money; regional Storage free benefits are US-only. Do not claim Mumbai build storage is always free.

budgets.note: Cloud Run/Functions support eligible service-scoped spend caps. Caps use gross estimates before credits, enforcement is not instant, and storage persists. Alerts-only budgets do not stop charges. No cap has been configured.

gaps: Actual billing statement and billing-account-wide free-tier consumption not inspected.
Retained weekly Cloud Monitoring aggregate usage report is unavailable (403); not zero usage.
Exact hosting of the installed GTOP ChatGPT App connector not exposed in available package/repository metadata.
recommendation: Keep low-traffic scale-to-zero operation, bounded source reads, image cleanup and complete usage visibility. A budget/ceiling value requires the author's choice; do not silently set a financial threshold or disable writing.
